tips.tip: Never share UPI PIN, OTP or card CVV, even with someone claiming to be support staff.
Open banking and government portals from their official website or saved bookmark instead of unknown links.
Real employers should not require large upfront deposits for interview, joining or document verification.
Check unusual lip-sync, lighting, facial edges, audio mismatch and the original source before trusting viral media.
Treat sudden requests for money from a known contact as suspicious; call the person on a trusted number.
Use strong unique passwords and never share them in chats, calls or forms sent by strangers.
